ch39-open.title: Guest manager
ch39-open.standfirst: The all-projects view for managing the clients you've issued — a shortcut into the credential tools covered in the Clients part.

c39-guestmgr.heading: Every project's guests, together
c39-guestmgr.lead: The sidebar's Guest manager gathers the clients you've issued across all your projects into one list, so you can find, edit, reset or revoke a guest without opening each project. It's the same toolset described in Client credentials — just the central door to it.
c39-guestmgr.body: Each guest stays scoped to its own project; the manager only saves you hunting for the right folder.
